summary: Recent updates in the Canvas area of Firefox have improved the performance and compatibility of WebGL, the technology used for rendering 2D and 3D graphics in web applications. Notably, they've introduced **shared Pixel Buffer Objects (PBO)** to enhance the efficiency of graphic uploads, and aligned WebGL buffer size limits with those in WebGPU, a new graphics API that optimizes rendering performance. These changes, along with several code clean-ups, help ensure smoother graphics handling and better utilization of system resources across different platforms, particularly with WebGL's integration of Metal on macOS. _While most users may not notice these changes directly, they contribute to a more robust and modern browsing experience._
